title: 1D locomotion BlendSpace on Speed
prompt: Create a 1D BlendSpace {root}/BS_Locomotion for the Mannequin skeleton /Game/Characters/Mannequins/Meshes/SK_Mannequin with one axis named Speed from 0 to 600. Samples: /Game/Characters/Mannequins/Anims/Unarmed/MM_Idle at Speed 0, /Game/Characters/Mannequins/Anims/Unarmed/Walk/MF_Unarmed_Walk_Fwd at Speed 200 and /Game/Characters/Mannequins/Anims/Unarmed/Jog/MF_Unarmed_Jog_Fwd at Speed 500.

tools.name: 1D, Speed axis 0..600
tools.expect: r['success'] and r['dimensions'] == 1 and r['axes'][0]['name'] == 'Speed' and r['axes'][0]['min'] == 0 and r['axes'][0]['max'] == 600

tools.name: idle 0, walk 200, jog 500
tools.expect: r['success'] and sorted((s['animation'].split('.')[-1], round(s['x'])) for s in r['samples']) == [('MF_Unarmed_Jog_Fwd', 500), ('MF_Unarmed_Walk_Fwd', 200), ('MM_Idle', 0)]
